calendar.matters:
HEARING ON RESPONDENT CHELSEA TAMULEVICH'S OPPOSITION TO PROPOSED NAME CHANGE OF THE TWO MINORS

Off Calendar May-28-2025 Dismissal
MINI MINUTES: Dept:505; Judge: Michelle Tong; Clerk: K.Valdes; Proceedings reported by "For the Record" commencing at 11:14:28 a.m. and concluding at 11:23:30 a.m.(D505)

In re: Petition to change name of minors Caspian Anthony Tamulevich and Valentino Dior Tamulevich.

Appearances:
Petitioner Frank Andrew Cordova appeared in pro per, was placed under oath and testified.
Alex Mendoza, Esq. representing Respondent Chelsea Tamulevich who was present.

Petitioner testifies as to the request the change in name of the minors.
The Court inquires as to why the petitioner filed in Civil Court instead in the Unified Family Court. Petitioner responds to the Court's inquiries.
The matter is discussed between all parties.

The Court finds that it has no authority to rule over the matter as petitioner and respondent have pre-existing Unified Family Court cases.

The Court DENIES the request of petitioner pursuant to the pre-existing Unified Family Court cases between Petitioner and Respodent.

Petitioner is to file the request for order with Unified Family Court.

The Petition to change names of minors Caspian Anthony Tamulevich and Valentino Dior Tamulevich is dismissed without prejudice.
